verification_report.summary: The program text correctly preserves the stated closedness, bounded-mass, lower-volume, and parabolic hypotheses in its literature claims; it also properly frames the proposed problems as open. One strict definition error remains: its opening description of Dang's non-Hermitian locus replaces the source's 'almost analytic singularities' by 'analytic singularities' without establishing equivalence.

critical_errors.location: Null loci and the singularities of the Chern--Ricci flow, opening definition of E_{nH}(theta)
critical_errors.issue: DangNull26 Definition 2.12 defines E_{nH}(theta) as the intersection of singular sets of Hermitian currents with almost analytic singularities. The manuscript instead specifies currents with analytic singularities. The source distinguishes these notions, and the manuscript supplies no equivalence in the possibly nonclosed setting.

repair_hints: Replace 'analytic singularities' by 'almost analytic singularities' in the definition of E_{nH}(theta) and use Dang's exact terminology thereafter. Alternatively, add a precise theorem, with hypotheses verified here, proving that the analytic-singularity formulation has the same locus in this nonclosed setting.
